    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChoiceToTraining</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChangePolicy" name="Change policy">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChoiceToPolicy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PolicyToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SolutionMerge"
                           name="Solution implemented"
                           gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FixToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PolicyToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToFollowUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUp" name="Follow up to prevent recurrence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToFollowUp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FollowUpToClose</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseReport" name="Close incident report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FollowUpToClose</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseToNotify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyStakeholders"
                   name="Notify all stakeholders"
                   messageRef="Message_ClosureNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseToNotify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_IncidentHandlingComplete"
                   name="Incident report closed and stakeholders notified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportReceivedToLog"
                       sourceRef="Event_IncidentReported"
                       targetRef="Task_LogReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogToAssign"
                       sourceRef="Task_LogReport"
                       targetRef="Task_AssignTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignToGather"
                       sourceRef="Task_AssignTeam"
                       targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherToIdentify"
                       sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation"
                       targetRef="Task_IdentifyCause"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyToPropose"
                       sourceRef="Task_IdentifyCause"
                       targetRef="Task_ProposeActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProposeToChoice"
                       sourceRef="Task_ProposeActions"
                       targetRef="Gateway_SolutionChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChoiceToFix"
                       name="Fix"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_SolutionChoice"
                       targetRef="Task_ApplyFix"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChoiceToTraining"
                       name="Training"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_SolutionChoice"
                       targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChoiceToPolicy"
                       name="Policy change"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_SolutionChoice"
                       targetRef="Task_ChangePolicy"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FixToMerge"
                       sourceRef="Task_ApplyFix"
                       targetRef="Gateway_SolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingToMerge"
                       sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining"
                       targetRef="Gateway_SolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PolicyToMerge"
                       sourceRef="Task_ChangePolicy"
                       targetRef="Gateway_SolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToFollowUp"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_SolutionMerge"
                       targetRef="Task_FollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUpToClose"
                       sourceRef="Task_FollowUp"
                       targetRef="Task_CloseReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseToNotify"
                       sourceRef="Task_CloseReport"
                       targetRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToEnd"
                       sourceRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders"
                       targetRef="Event_IncidentHandlingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that one of several alternatives is selected, or that an activity may occur: Model the choice or optional activity with an appropriate gateway, and reconnect the resulting paths before subsequent common work.
rules.situation: the description presents multiple mutually alternative ways to carry out a single action

rules.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules.situation: the description states meaningful process triggers or outcomes, or describes activities with specific actions and objects

rules.instruction: When the description names multiple required activities in a phase, gives no order among them, and states that a later outcome occurs only after the phase is finished: Model each activity separately, use a parallel split for the unordered activities, and join their branches before modeling the later outcome.
rules.situation: the description lists multiple required activities without stating an order and says a later activity follows after those activities are completed

rules.instruction: When the description states that information is reported or submitted and separately says it is later entered or recorded in a system: Model the reporting or submission and the later system-recording work as separate BPMN elements; do not treat the initial report as completing the recording activity.
rules.situation: the description states that information is reported or submitted and separately says it is later entered or recorded in a system

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states that an actor performs an action that initiates the described process: Model the stated action as an activity in the actor’s scope; do not use a start event representing the resulting occurrence as a substitute for that activity. Represent the process start separately with an appropriate start event.
rules.situation: the description states that an actor performs an action that initiates the process, and separately describes subsequent work using the information produced by that action

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states the outcome that ends the process: Label the BPMN end event with a concise phrase that preserves that stated outcome rather than using a generic label.
rules.situation: the description explicitly states the outcome that ends the process
